rationale_one_line: Warp (warm campfire terminal aesthetic) maps directly to oh-my-pi (terminal agent) and gives Can Bolu the restrained, low-color register a reverse engineer would write his own product page in; SCHEMATIC gives the hash-anchored-edits idea a center-stage diagram.
writing_tone_notes: Lowercase by default. Terse declaratives. No marketing adjectives. Treat the reader as a peer who's already built one of these. The voice is the secret-club blog tone applied to a tribute.
do_rules: Lead the diagram with the content-hash anchor as the pivot node.
Use Rust and TypeScript stack details as flavor in the terminal scene, not in the headline beats.
Keep the reverse-engineer pivot for the close, not the caption (caption leads with star velocity).
Hold to lowercase except for proper nouns and the close's primary line.
Camera moves: at least four distinct, one orbit on the diagram scene.
dont_rules: Do NOT repeat 'hash-anchored edits' verbatim across caption + scene copy (caption gets the phrase; the diagram says 'anchors by content hash').
Do NOT echo 'reverse engineer' in the caption AND the close subtitle (close gets it).
Do NOT reuse 'harness' as a phrase across more than one surface.
Do NOT cite v15.2.4 or any version number in the caption (growth metric only).
Do NOT use em or en dashes anywhere in copy.
